description: Sixteen-voice sample player — one sample loaded, and sixteen channels each taking their own slice of it

params.text: Chooses which of the sixteen channels the controls are editing, 0 to 15; every channel keeps its own settings
Sets where in the sample that channel starts, the beginning at one end and the end at the other
Sets how much of the sample that channel plays from its start point, none at one end and all of it at the other
Loops that channel's slice while the gate is held, on the gate setting
Sets how fast that channel reads the sample, stopped at 0 and ten times at the top, and the pitch rises with it
Switches that channel between playing its slice right through on a trigger and playing only while the gate is held
Slices the sample into eight even pieces and lays them across the first eight channels
Slices the sample into sixteen even pieces and lays them across the sixteen channels
Slices the sample into thirty-two even pieces and lays the first sixteen across the channels
Slices the sample into sixty-four even pieces and lays the first sixteen across the channels

inputs.text: Starts a channel playing; it is polyphonic, and the channel that plays is the polyphony channel the trigger arrives on
Patching anything here switches the channels between trig and gate, but the value read in this version comes from the SPEED jack rather than this one
0V to 10V moves that channel's start point across the whole sample, added to the knob
0V to 10V adds to that channel's length across its whole range
0V here turns that channel's loop off
0V to 10V adds to that channel's speed, up to ten times

outputs.text: The sixteen channels, one per polyphony channel; use a split module to take them apart

notes: nothing plays until a sample is loaded: choose Load sample from the right-click menu, or drop a wav or aiff file onto the panel; the lamp goes green once one is in
the sample is played in mono, so a stereo file is mixed down as it is loaded, and a file recorded at another rate is converted to the engine's sample rate
menu: Load sample — opens a wav or aiff file and loads it as the sample
